stops: At every moment but $ct = 0$ the circles grow faster than the distance out to them, so the slice lies in Minkowski space.
caption: The equator ($\psi = \theta = \pi/2$) of the global chart from $ct = -r_c$ to $r_c$ in three dimensional Minkowski space, its circles of radius $(r_c + |y|)\cosh(ct/r_c)$, each side a cone, $Z = y\sinh(ct/r_c)$, meeting the other at the wall.
